name: ecommerce
description: An online store back office. Refunds require a return eligibility check first; cancellations are only valid before an order ships.

tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by free text, customer, or status. Read-only. Use to find an order when you do not have its exact id.

query.description: Free text, customer name, or order id fragment.

customer_id.description: Optional customer to scope the search.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Fetch a single order by its exact order id. Read-only. Includes current status such as pending, shipped, or delivered.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog by free text or category. Read-only. Use when no specific product id is known.

category.description: Optional category to scope the search.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single product's details (description, price, attributes) by its exact product id. Read-only. Does not report stock level.

tools.name: check_inventory
tools.description: Check the current stock level for a product id. Read-only. Use for quantity-on-hand, not for product description or price.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a customer profile by customer id. Read-only.

tools.name: check_return_eligibility
tools.description: Check whether an order qualifies for a return or refund under policy. This MUST be called and pass before any refund is issued.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Issue a refund for an order. Only call after check_return_eligibility has confirmed the order is eligible. Moves money.

amount.description: Optional partial amount; omit for a full refund.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order. Only valid while the order has not yet shipped; check the order's status first. Irreversible once shipped.

tools.name: apply_discount
tools.description: Apply a discount code to an order. Adjusts the order total; verify the code is valid for that order.

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Get shipment tracking status and location for an order. Read-only.
